text:
Sofia (CS Ops): captured three recurring asks from onboarding calls this week — dropping a concise summary so product + eng can triage.

Maya (Customer Success): +1, saw this across NovaHealth, Brightline, SummitHealth onboarding sessions.

Sofia (CS Ops): 1) Per-route configurable quotas & alerts
- Pain: customers want quota limits per API route to avoid noisy endpoints consuming dedicated capacity during spikes.
- Frequency: reported by 5 customers in last 7 days.
- Customer impact: causes unexpected throttling and support tickets; blocks predictable capacity planning.

2) Per-token cost attribution by org/team (not just account)
- Pain: finance/finance ops can't map token spend to internal teams, complicates chargebacks and renewals.
- Frequency: 3 customers asked; one is evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted.

3) SSO onboarding flow: auto-provisioning + clearer error messaging
- Pain: current SAML steps result in repeated handoffs to SE; increases time-to-first-call.
- Frequency: 4 customers; heavy for enterprise deals.

Liam (PM): thanks. Quick asks: can CS add rough ARR/seat size for each customer? helps prioritization. Also suggest labeling each ask with proposed priority (P0/P1/P2).

Maya (Customer Success): added notes inline in our CS tracker, will paste ARR next.

Arjun (Product): Initial thoughts: #2 is product+analytics; likely medium effort but high strategic value for renewals. #1 might need infra routing + rate-limiter changes. #3 is UX + docs + minor infra tweaks.

Evan (Eng): technical note: per-route quotas require extending our quota service to route-level keys and cached enforcement in the runtime. Estimated ~2 sprint effort for a small team + infra changes for metrics.

infra-bot: ticket created -> CS-1423 (per-route quotas), PRO-847 (token attribution research), ONB-512 (SSO flow improvements)

Sofia (CS Ops): proposed prioritization to start: #2 (P0), #3 (P1), #1 (P1) — rationale: #2 directly impacts renewals and finance asks.

Liam (PM): agree to treat #2 as P0. Can we get a quick spike (2 wk) for PRO-847 to validate data model? @Evan can you own the spike?

Evan (Eng): I can take the spike. Will scope by EOD Monday and link PRs.

Arjun (Product): assign owners: PRO-847 (Evan), ONB-512 (Sofia + docs), CS-1423 (Arjun -> Eng infra lead). We'll review in next product sync.

Maya (Customer Success): will send affected account list + ARR details to PRO-847.

Sofia (CS Ops): action items:
- Maya: account list + ARR -> PRO-847
- Evan: spike plan by Mon -> PRO-847
- Arjun: coordinate infra owner -> CS-1423
- Sofia: draft enablement playbook for ONB-512

Sofia (CS Ops): quick poll: react :thumbsup: to push #2 into next sprint, :eyes: to backlog. Add emoji so we can close this thread.

(6 reactions: :thumbsup: from Liam, Maya; :eyes: from Arjun)

Sofia (CS Ops): thanks all — marking this thread as captured and will update ticket comments as items move forward.
